How essay practice works

1

Choose a question

Pick one from the bank, or paste your own. Every question shows what support it carries before you start.

2

Write one paragraph at a time

A coach works through the response with you, one sentence at a time, or you can switch to a full timed attempt.

3

Get feedback

Your writing is read against the marking guidance for the question, and the guidance says where it came from.
